Description: Framedash self-hosted pilot: one EC2 instance, encrypted retained data volume, SQS and S3. Requires existing public subnet and explicit account verification.

Metadata.ExpectedAccountId: Deployment tooling must compare STS caller Account to ExpectedAccountId before creating or updating this stack.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.arch: One bounded trial host runs shared application images and private local databases; managed queues and object storage survive host replacement.
must: Account must match ExpectedAccountId in the deployment workflow.
One instance only; auto-stop bounds runtime, not total spend.
No inbound access in the default SSM-only trial.

AllowedClientCidr.Description: Operator or office IPv4 CIDR allowed to use HTTPS, with prefix 1 through 32. All /0 CIDRs, including 0.0.0.0/0, are forbidden.

InstanceType.Description: One instance only. t3.xlarge has 16 GiB for image builds; t3.large is an optional cheaper runtime test.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: The default consumer leaves failed telemetry in the DLQ for operator diagnosis, subject to SQS retention expiry.
must: Do not consume the DLQ automatically; explicit discard deletes acknowledged messages and retention expiry also removes them.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Durable delivery separates request acceptance from database availability.
must: Consumer processing must tolerate repeat delivery.
Preserve the dead-letter queue relationship.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Uploaded assets survive application-host loss without exposing data publicly.
must: Keep encryption and public-access blocking.
Retain versions until the operator completes recovery or data-disposal review.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Transport enforcement also applies to requests allowed by identity policies.
must: Deny insecure transport; do not add public allow statements.
Retain the transport policy with its retained bucket.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Instance identity avoids static AWS credentials in the application distribution.
must: Application grants remain scoped to this stack queues and bucket.
Do not grant secret-read or account-administration actions to the application role.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: EC2 supplies rotating workload credentials through instance metadata.
must: Keep the instance role relationship; no user access keys.

Properties.GroupDescription: Framedash optional HTTP/HTTPS for the nominated CIDR; no default ingress.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: SSM access removes the need for inbound administration ports.
must: Default trial has no inbound rules.
Do not expose PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis or SSH.
Optional public listeners remain scoped to the nominated client CIDR.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: A separate persistent disk permits cold backup independently of disposable application images.
must: Zone must match the selected subnet and instance.
Keep encryption and snapshot policies on deletion or replacement.
Bootstrap never formats disks. The operator must positively verify a newly created blank volume before its explicit initialization during the bounded bootstrap wait.

Fn::Join:
'
finish_bootstrap() {
  status=$?
  trap - EXIT
  set +e
  for attempt in $(seq 1 5); do
    /opt/aws/bin/cfn-signal -e "$status" --stack "$stack_name" --resource Instance --region "$region" && exit "$status"
    sleep 5
  done
  exit 1
}
trap finish_bootstrap EXIT

cat > /etc/systemd/system/framedash-autostop.service <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Stop the Framedash pilot instance
[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/shutdown -h now
EOF
cat > /etc/systemd/system/framedash-autostop.timer <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Bound the Framedash pilot runtime
[Timer]
OnBootSec=

h
Unit=framedash-autostop.service
[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
EOF
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now framedash-autostop.timer

dnf install -y aws-cfn-bootstrap docker git nodejs22 nodejs22-npm
alternatives --set node /usr/bin/node-22
node -e 'if (process.versions.node.split(".")[0] !== "22") process.exit(1)'
systemctl disable --now docker
install -d /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins
compose_version=v2.39.4
curl --fail --location "https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/download/$compose_version/docker-compose-linux-x86_64" -o /tmp/docker-compose-linux-x86_64
curl --fail --location "https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/download/$compose_version/checksums.txt" -o /tmp/checksums.txt
(cd /tmp && grep -E ' [*]?docker-compose-linux-x86_64$' checksums.txt | sha256sum --check)
install -m 755 /tmp/docker-compose-linux-x86_64 /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose
volume_id=

volume_serial=${volume_id//-/}
device=/dev/disk/by-id/nvme-Amazon_Elastic_Block_Store_$volume_serial
for attempt in $(seq 1 120); do
  test -b "$device" && break
  sleep 5
done
test -b "$device"
wait_for_data_filesystem() {
  deadline=$((SECONDS + 1200))
  udevadm settle --timeout=10
  while ((SECONDS < deadline)); do
    if filesystem=$(blkid --probe -s TYPE -o value "$device"); then
      test "$filesystem" = ext4 || return 1
      return 0
    fi
    sleep 5
  done
  return 1
}
printf 'Waiting up to 20 minutes for operator-initialized ext4 on the exact data volume.\n'
wait_for_data_filesystem
install -d /srv/framedash
uuid=$(blkid --probe -s UUID -o value "$device")
test -n "$uuid"
grep -q "$uuid" /etc/fstab || printf 'UUID=%s /srv/framedash ext4 defaults,x-systemd.device-timeout=120s 0 2\n' "$uuid" >> /etc/fstab
mount /srv/framedash
printf '#!/bin/bash\nset -euo pipefail\nmountpoint -q /srv/framedash\ntest "$(findmnt -rn -o UUID --mountpoint /srv/framedash)" = "%s"\n' "$uuid" > /usr/local/sbin/framedash-data-ready
chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/framedash-data-ready
/usr/local/sbin/framedash-data-ready
install -d /etc/systemd/system/docker.service.d
cat > /etc/systemd/system/docker.service.d/framedash-data.conf <<'EOF'
[Unit]
RequiresMountsFor=/srv/framedash
BindsTo=srv-framedash.mount
After=srv-framedash.mount
[Service]
ExecStartPre=/usr/local/sbin/framedash-data-ready
EOF
install -d -m 700 /srv/framedash/data
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now docker
docker info > /dev/null
printf 'Framedash infrastructure ready; application installation and secret configuration are manual.\n'

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: A single host limits trial complexity and avoids managed-database and NAT fixed costs. The managed VPC rule reads only top-level SubnetId; pilot.guard verifies the actual network-interface subnet instead.
must: Install the auto-stop timer before dependencies so setup failure remains bounded.
Require IMDSv2 with a container-compatible hop limit.
Attach the existing data volume within this resource to avoid a signal/attachment dependency cycle.
Signal successful creation only after Node 22, the exact data mount and guarded Docker startup pass.
Docker must stop or refuse startup if the data mount disappears or its UUID changes.
Use standard CPU credits and preserve termination protection.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Optional stable address supports a later DNS deployment without changing application URLs.
must: Create only when the reviewed public HTTPS path is enabled.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: DNS must continue to identify the nominated application host after a stop/start.
must: Keep the address attached only to this stack instance.

ExpectedAccountId.Description: Account expected by the guarded deployment workflow.

PublicIp.Description: Optional stable DNS address or the SSM trial instance public address.

DataVolumeId.Description: Exact persistent data disk for snapshot and restore.

QueueUrl.Description: Telemetry queue used by ingest and consumer.

DeadLetterQueueUrl.Description: Failed telemetry left unconsumed by default, subject to 14-day expiry; explicit discard is irreversible.

Region.Description: Region for the application AWS SDK clients.
